concepts.quote: for (int i = 0; i < data2.length(); i++) copy[i] = data2[i];
concepts.why: Standard header giving i each index 0..N-1 once to process every element; the loop structure is right though the bound expression carries the .length() slip.
Builds a separate array and copies element by element, i.e. a traversal of every index of the original rather than an alias, but the code is not L4 because it does not compile as written.
